"I Love a Rainy Night" is a song co-written and recorded by American country music artist Eddie Rabbitt.
It was released in November 1980 as the second single from his album Horizon.
It reached number one on the Hot Country Singles, Billboard Hot 100, and Adult Contemporary Singles charts in early 1981.
Horizon is the sixth studio album by American country music artist Eddie Rabbitt.
It was released in 1980 under the Elektra Records label.
The album produced two singles, both of which reached number one on country charts.
Edward Thomas Rabbitt (November 27, 1941 – May 7, 1998) was an American country music singer and songwriter.
